notes.title: Update #3: Bots, Cubes, performance and more.
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

We are thrilled to present another update that brings a series of improvements to The Balls. Here's an overview of the most important changes in the latest update:

[h3][b]Bots Optimization[/b][/h3]
After closely monitoring gameplay, it was clear that our last update had given the Bots a bit too much of a combat edge. To address this, their accuracy has been slightly reduced. This adjustment means they'll still present a challenge without being overwhelmingly dangerous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/a6e985180390319d1f0e65c3608d26b08642c96c.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Graphical Fixes[/b][/h3]
We introduced several UI/UX improvements to enhance game readability, including: improving the readability of the friends panel, new icons for the Moving Cubes and Western maps, and changing the death icon caused by exiting the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/f16a12d083b9b4daa5ca0b6e42f0caf97156e37e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Dungeon Castle Map[/b][/h3]
We've made enhancements to the Dungeon Castle map by sealing off the castle walls. There's a 98% probability that we've successfully repaired those sections of the map that previously let you soar out of the combat arena. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/3ddd351cc05c38158acfe3cd65d932ef4ea215d2.png[/img]

[h3][b]Friends Panel Fixes[/b][/h3]
Issues causing performance drops due to friends' status synchronization with Steam have been tackled. Expect a smoother game experience, no matter how extensive your friends list is.

As always, we encourage you to share your opinions and suggestions, which are invaluable to us.

See you in the game!

notes.title: Maps and Bot Balance Enhancements
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have some additional fixes for you to enhance overall gameplay quality. Here are the most important ones:

[h3][b]Bot Balance[/b][/h3]
The Bots were moving like molasses and did not pose as much of a threat as we expected. Therefore, we decided to give them a boost. They move faster and shoot more accurately! Remember, Bots are marked with a [b][B][/b] symbol next to their name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/a6e985180390319d1f0e65c3608d26b08642c96c.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Map changes: Western[/b][/h3]
Bots on this map were not very visible and often got lost in the mines under the village. Now, they should move on the surface much more frequently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/80b62ee7a20a7970e928f2b1f00ec08c0464a3fa.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Map changes: Dungeon Castle[/b][/h3]
In deathmatch mode, water will no longer flood the entire castle, opening up new strategies and possibilities for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/9e88f354a6483e53f4b3683e2a38280a30a645ed.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Map changes: Ancient[/b][/h3]
We noticed that the Ancient map was too extensive, which negatively impacted the dynamics of the gameplay. To address this, we reduced the radius of the bounding sphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/2cd49962f3ca0cd512820955f90ea687d17e8893.jpg[/img]

As always, we look forward to your feedback and suggestions! :)

See you in the game and on Discord: https://discord.gg/Jg8KySeUmX

notes.title: First major update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to welcome you to our first major update since the game's launch! We're extremely happy to share with you some new additions and tweaks that we hope will improve your gaming experience.

[h1]What's Changed?[/h1]

[h3][b]New Map: Western[/b][/h3] 
Transport yourselves to a small town in the wild west.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/5090ab4ff5381e3e2a032ae94b8491714f3e4efe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/f8c4b52b9f5811b88553e77f9865ec542b183166.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Map: Dungeon Castle[/b][/h3] 
Face challenges on the medieval map – watch out not to drown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/ec1a64a39fec24ef17cc8e7de3ff89b6c12302a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/8686889303dcb4c46342205094fbae5e7aae73c8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Cubes Mechanic[/b][/h3] 
We're introducing an exciting change to the building mechanic! Now, Cubes are explosive and will detonate as soon as an enemy approaches them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787603/969295b9edc3327d4810599fa163ddbc64232a8d.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h3] 
We've resolved an issue that prevented the game from launching on PCs with older graphics cards. Now, everyone should be able to enjoy the game without any obstacles.

[h3][b]Other Minor Graphical Improvements[/b][/h3] 
We've implemented a series of graphical and optimization improvements to ensure smoother gameplay.


Thank you for supporting our game, more updates are coming soon. Oh, and before I forget, make sure to join our [b]Discord channel:[/b] https://discord.gg/Jg8KySeUmX
